title: Breaking the Speed Limit of Chemical-Structure Imaging with Enhanced Force Sensitivity
summary: A new atomic force microscope captures the structures of individual molecules and their chemical bonds at record speeds.

title: Anomaly in Canonical Semiclassical Gravity
summary: We show that the canonical formulation of the semiclassical Einstein equation, where the matter terms in the constraints are replaced by expectation values of the corresponding operators in quantum states, is inconsistent due to the nonclosure of the resulting constraint algebra.

title: Search for Sub-GeV Dark Particles in $η→{π}^{0}+\text{Invisible}$ Decay
summary: BESIII collaboration performs the first search for a sub-GeV dark scalar in decays using over 10 billion events, observing no signal.

title: Microscopic Evidence for a Zhang-Rice Triplet State in the van der Waals Antiferromagnet, ${\mathrm{NiPS}}_{3}$
summary: Nuclear magnetic resonance measurements verify the Zhang-Rice triplet ground state in the van der Waals antiferromagnet NiPS .

title: Directional Photocurrent Generated by Quantum Interference Control
summary: Using higher-order quantum interference, an “electron lighthouse” is created with the capability of optically steering highly directional 2D beams of photocurrent in semiconductors.

title: Superradiant Parametric Mössbauer Radiation Source
summary: Future applications of the spectrally narrow x-ray resonances in Mössbauer nuclei require x-ray sources with exceptionally high peak and average spectral flux. Here, we introduce a superradiant parametric Mössbauer radiation (SPMR) source, which utilizes the scattering of spatially microstructured e…

title: Limits of Inference in Complex Systems: When Stochastic Models Become Indistinguishable
summary: A path-inference framework quantifies data resolution limits that render distinct stochastic models empirically indistinguishable and offers guidelines for designing experimental measurements that maximize information extraction.

title: Agentic Exploration of Physics Models
summary: ꜱᴄɪᴇxᴘʟᴏʀᴇʀ, a generalist artificial scientist agent based on a large-language model, automates the process of scientific research and discovery and uncovers underlying models of diverse physical systems without task-specific fine-tuning.

authors: Julio C. Magdalena de la Fuente
title: Universal Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computation in 2D without Getting Tied in Knots
summary: Researchers have designed a way to perform complex logic gates in two-dimensional quantum computers by temporarily moving data into an exotic non-Abelian phase. This method provides a path toward large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computation.

title: Multiscale Interfacial Mechanics of Soft Solids
summary: Using high-precision 3D location and tracking of nanotracers, this work investigates interfacial properties and mechanical response of soft polymer solids, revealing the multiscale nature of soft solid interfaces.

title: Beyond Stellar Rank: Control Parameters for Scalable Optical Non-Gaussian State Generation
summary: Researchers have introduced new non-Gaussian control parameters that allow for the systematic optimization of quantum light sources. This breakthrough can increase the success rate of generating essential quantum states by orders of magnitude.

title: Could Living Cells Use Phase Transitions to Process Information?
summary: This Perspective explores biomolecular condensation as a powerful framework for computation, enabling cells to process high-dimensional information to sense, classify, and respond to complex environmental signals.

title: Probing Excited-State Dynamics of Transmon Ionization
summary: Researchers probe “transmon ionization,” revealing how qubits escape their computational states into highly excited states via multiphoton resonances. Understanding these Landau-Zener transitions is an important step toward developing better readout schemes.

title: Breakdown of the Thermodynamic Limit in Quantum Spin and Dimer Models
summary: Geometry-induced quantum phase separation in quantum dimer models demonstrates that domain shape can fundamentally alter macroscopic ground states, challenging traditional assumptions about the thermodynamic limit.

title: Subsurface Driven Size-Dependent Elasticity in Nanodiamond
summary: Subsurface compliant regions in nanodiamond allow for an elastic response to strain, providing a method for engineering the mechanical properties of brittle materials like diamond.

title: Boosting the Thermoelectric Performance of $α$-MgAgSb through Phase-Transition-Induced Self-Doping
summary: A doping-free approach is able to boost thermoelectric performance, providing an attractive route for developing waste heat recovery technologies.

title: Active Hydrodynamic Theory of Euchromatin and Heterochromatin
summary: Researchers develop a theoretical framework that shows how mechanical forces and flows drive the spatial segregation and nucleus-wide patterning of chromatin in cells.

title: Nearly Isotropic Upper Critical Field in Pressurized Trilayer Nickelate ${\mathrm{La}}_{4}{\mathrm{Ni}}_{3}{\mathrm{O}}_{10−δ}$
summary: Angle-dependent magnetotransport measurements under extreme pressure reveal an isotropic upper critical field in trilayer nickelates driven by the compensation of distinct electronic orbitals.

title: Physics-Based Factorized Machine Learning for Predicting Ionic Dielectric Tensors
summary: A machine-learning methodology helps screen thousands of candidate oxides to identify materials with excellent dielectric properties.

title: Targeted Calibration to Adjust Stability Biases in Complex Dynamical System Models
summary: A method is introduced for systematic calibration of complex dynamical system models, targeted at adjusting system stability, with applications to climate models.

title: Ultralow-Power Microwave Frequency Comb at a Bistable Phase Transition
summary: Leveraging a bistable phase transition in a hybrid quantum system enables the generation of a microwave frequency comb with 193 spectral teeth at unprecedentedly low driving power.

title: Traveling-Wave Parametric Amplifier with Passive Reverse Isolation
summary: By integrating passive reverse isolation into a multistage architecture, a new traveling-wave parametric amplifier with near-quantum-limited performance protects sensitive qubits from thermal backaction, enabling a scalable isolator-free readout architecture for superconducting quantum computers.

title: Observation of Nonadiabatic Landau-Zener Tunneling among Floquet States
summary: Spectroscopic data reveal copper electronic states transitioning to nonadiabatic Landau-Zener tunneling among Floquet states under intense light.

title: Harnessing Quantum Backaction for Time-Series Processing
summary: Tuning the strength of indirect measurements in quantum reservoir computing is shown to enhance memory and performance for processing time-series data, providing a way to turn quantum backaction into a resource.

title: Quantum-State-Controlled Collisions of Ultracold Polyatomic Molecules
summary: Ultracold collisions between polyatomic molecules are observed and characterized, revealing how their unique internal structure can be used to shield them from loss.

title: Photonic Restricted Boltzmann Machine for Content Generation Tasks
summary: A newly developed photonic restricted Boltzmann machine accelerates generative artificial intelligence by executing complex Gibbs sampling optically, overcoming traditional electronic computing bottlenecks.

title: Fermion Quantum Criticality far from Equilibrium
summary: A new nonequilibrium universality class for fermions is identified. It displays an emergent “dark state symmetry” that protects quantum criticality, requiring only a single tuning parameter.

title: Continuous Variable Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Certification
summary: Researchers demonstrate a measurement-device-independent certification for continuous-variable systems. By using coherent states, they show that entanglement and memory can be verified even with untrusted hardware.

title: Hydrostatic Pressure-Enhanced Correlated Magnetism and Chern Insulator in Moiré ${\mathrm{WSe}}_{2}$
summary: Hydrostatic pressure acts as a reversible control knob in twisted WSe to enhance ferromagnetism and drive topological phase transitions between Chern and Mott insulating states.

title: Deterministic 1D Domain Wall Motion with Nucleation-Free Nature in Sliding Ferroelectric Switching
summary: Sliding ferroelectrics possess a nucleation-free nature, where collective and constrained domain wall motion enables deterministic polarization control far beyond conventional ferroelectrics.

title: Fast Scrambling at the Boundary
summary: Researchers find that a simple boundary quantum spin in the multichannel Kondo model can scramble information as fast as the most complex random systems, revealing a link between impurity physics and fast scramblers.

title: Resource-Theoretical Unification of Mpemba Effects: Classical and Quantum
summary: A unified theory of Mpemba effects across a variety of contexts is provided using resource theories. Faster relaxation occurs when states with a larger amount of resources have a smaller overlap with the slowest resourceful relaxation channel.

title: Scalable Photonic Quantum Interconnect Platform
summary: A wafer-scale platform integrating high-quality diamond membranes with functionalized silicon substrates enables the parallel fabrication of quantum memory arrays with near-unity yield, paving the way for the mass production of modular quantum interconnects.

title: Cooperative Charge Ordering Signature of Trimer Molecules in Infinite-Layer ${\mathrm{CaCoO}}_{2}$
summary: Resonant x-ray scattering in CaCoO reveals a quasi-three-dimensional trimer charge order linked to interlayer orbital hybridization, establishing molecular units as key organizers for macroscopic electronic states.

title: Slow Quasiparticle Dynamics and Anyonic Statistics in a Fractional Quantum Hall Fabry-Pérot Interferometer
summary: Anyons, collective excitations of fractional quantum Hall systems, are shown to exhibit unprecedented stability in graphene heterostructures, enabling their practical manipulation for use in fault-tolerant quantum computing.

title: Observation of Anomalous Floquet Non-Abelian Topological Insulators
summary: An anomalous Floquet non-Abelian topological insulator is realized in an acoustic system, exhibiting robust edge states across all band gaps, despite a trivial bulk charge, and unique topological interface modes arising from noncommutative dynamics.

title: High-Fidelity Control of a $^{13}\mathrm{C}$ Nuclear Spin Coupled to a Tin-Vacancy Center in Diamond
summary: High-fidelity control of a C nuclear spin coupled to a tin-vacancy center yields coherence times exceeding 1.35 s using a superconducting waveguide, highlighting the potential of the tin-vacancy center as a coherent spin-photon interface for future quantum network applications.

title: Superconductivity via Paramagnon and Magnon Exchange in a 2D Near-Ferromagnetic Full Metal and Ferromagnetic Half-Metal
summary: Theoretical analysis of two-dimensional electron systems shows that magnon-mediated interactions drive robust -wave superconductivity within a ferromagnetically order state at a temperature significantly higher than in a paramagnetic state.

title: Fast Sideband Control of a Multimode Cavity Memory with Weak Dispersive Coupling to a Transmon
summary: Researchers use fast “sideband control” to swap quantum information between a processor and a superconducting-cavity memory far faster than traditional dispersive methods, even when the two are only weakly coupled. This enables robust encoding gates and reliable quantum storage in high-quality superconducting cavities.

title: Persistent Spin Currents in Superconducting Altermagnets
summary: Persistent spin currents in superconducting altermagnets offer a dissipationless mechanism for spin transport that could enable the development of high-efficiency spintronic computer chips.

title: Stabilization of Cat-State Manifolds Using Nonlinear Reservoir Engineering
summary: A nonlinear reservoir engineering approach is proposed, enabling the stabilization and error correction of multicomponent Schrödinger cat manifolds through the destructive interference of nonlinear gain and loss processes.

title: Superconductivity from Spin-Canting Fluctuations in Rhombohedral Graphene
summary: A study predicts that soft magnon modes arising from spin-canting order can give rise to Cooper pairing in spin-orbit-proximitized rhombohedral graphene, naturally accounting for various experimentally observed trends.

title: Quantum boomerang effect in time-crystalline structures
